## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (6)
- `GET /api/v4/captcha/challenge` — Request a CAPTCHA challenge for authentication.
- `GET /api/v4/user/iam/dash-authz-eval-roles` — Retrieve user IAM roles for authorization (auth flow).
- `GET /static/vendor/onetrust/{onetrustToken}/consent/{consentId}/{consentId}/en.json` — Get OneTrust consent data in JSON format (auth flow).
- `GET /static/vendor/onetrust/{onetrustToken}/consent/{consentId}/{consentToken}` — Retrieve user consent data from OneTrust (auth flow).
- `GET /static/vendor/onetrust/{onetrustToken}/scripttemplates/202510.2.0/assets/otFlat.json` — Download OneTrust script template assets (auth flow).
- `GET /static/vendor/onetrust/{onetrustToken}/scripttemplates/202510.2.0/assets/v2/otPcCenter.json` — Download OneTrust PC center assets (auth flow).

### Data Read (2)
- `GET /api/v4/notifications` — Fetch user notifications.
- `POST /api/gates/api/v1/runtime/assignments` — Get runtime assignments from the gates API.

### Config (1)
- `GET /api/v4/system/bootstrap` — Fetch system bootstrap configuration.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /api/v1/{v1Id}` — Send a request to a core API endpoint.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Dash Cloudflare's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Dash Cloudflare data without official API access
- Automate actions on dash.cloudflare.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Dash Cloudflare frontend uses
